title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: FYI, local prep kid Colin Czajkowski wants to go pro. His dad was my 6th grade math teacher. He is committed to Michigan but will sign. I don’t feel comfortable saying numbers - let’s just say you guys are hometown team - but ATL, LAA, PHI and I heard you guys were poking around. I asked his dad if I could pass this info on to people and he said yes
Thanks. Our scout said he is asking for to much $$
Do you have any bonus details on Greene contract...over/under slot?
